tool_schemas.name: scrape_webpage
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and renders a single URL under the given profile and creates an execution record with page artifacts, optionally including stored/returned HTML and/or a screenshot. Returns the scrape job metadata plus the captured content/artifact references; this endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_id is not a Hyperbrowser profile ULID, url is not a valid URI, wait_for is negative, or unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the profile_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the profile; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account/profile has no remaining scrape capacity.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the scrape under.

url.description: The webpage URL to fetch and scrape.

wait_for.description: Milliseconds to wait after initial load to allow dynamic content to render.

include_html.description: Whether to store/return the page HTML artifact.

include_screenshot.description: Whether to store/return a screenshot artifact.

tool_schemas.name: crawl_webpages
tool_schemas.description: Starts a crawl execution under the given profile from start_url, following links up to max_depth and up to max_pages, optionally restricting to the same domain and optionally storing/returning HTML and/or screenshots per page. Returns a crawl job record with summary statistics and references to the collected page artifacts/results; this endpoint is not paged (paging applies when you later list the crawl’s pages/results). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_id is invalid, start_url is not a valid URI, max_pages < 1, max_depth < 0, or unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the profile does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the profile; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when crawl limits or account capacity would be exceeded.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the crawl under.

start_url.description: Seed URL where the crawler starts.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch during the crawl.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to follow from the start URL.

same_domain_only.description: Whether to restrict crawling to the same domain as the start URL.

include_html.description: Whether to store/return HTML artifacts for crawled pages.

include_screenshot.description: Whether to store/return screenshot artifacts for crawled pages.

tool_schemas.name: extract_structured_data
tool_schemas.description: Renders the target URL under the given profile and runs a structured extraction pass using the provided schema, persisting an execution record and extracted JSON output. Returns the extraction job metadata along with the extracted structured result (and any associated artifacts recorded for the run); this endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_id is invalid, url is not a valid URI, schema is missing/invalid, wait_for is negative, or unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the profile does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the profile; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if extraction usage limits are reached.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the extraction under.

url.description: The webpage URL to extract data from.

schema.description: User-provided schema describing the structured fields to extract.

wait_for.description: Milliseconds to wait after initial load to allow dynamic content to render.

tool_schemas.name: browser_use_agent
tool_schemas.description: This tool employs an open-source browser automation agent optimized specifically for fast, efficient, and cost-effective browser tasks using a cloud browser. It requires explicit, detailed instructions to perform highly specific interactions quickly. Optimal for tasks requiring: - Precise, explicitly defined interactions and actions - Speed and efficiency with clear, unambiguous instructions - Cost-effective automation at scale with straightforward workflows Best suited use cases include: - Explicitly defined registration and login processes - Clearly guided navigation through web apps - Structured, step-by-step web scraping with detailed guidance - Extracting data via explicitly specified browser interactions You must provide extremely detailed step-by-step instructions, including exact elements, actions, and explicit context. Clearly define the desired outcome for optimal results. Returns the completed result or an error message if issues arise. Note: This agent trades off flexibility for significantly faster performance and lower costs compared to Claude and OpenAI agents.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the agent session under.

instructions.description: Explicit step-by-step task instructions for the browser agent.

start_url.description: Optional initial URL to open before executing instructions.

tool_schemas.name: openai_computer_use_agent
tool_schemas.description: This tool utilizes OpenAI's model to autonomously execute general-purpose browser-based tasks with balanced performance and reliability using a cloud browser. It handles complex interactions effectively with practical reasoning and clear execution. Optimal for tasks requiring: - Reliable, general-purpose browser automation - Clear, structured interactions with moderate complexity - Efficient handling of common web tasks and workflows Best suited use cases include: - Standard multi-step registration or form submissions - Navigating typical web applications requiring multiple interactions - Conducting structured web research tasks - Extracting data through interactive web processes Provide a clear step-by-step description, necessary context, and expected outcomes. Returns the completed result or an error message if issues arise.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the agent session under.

instructions.description: Task instructions for the OpenAI-powered computer-use agent.

start_url.description: Optional initial URL to open before executing instructions.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def openai_computer_use_agent(profile_id, instructions, start_url=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid, urllib.parse
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0163000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0163000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Load datastore
    profiles = _load("profiles.json")
    jobs = _load("jobs.json")
    sessions = _load("agent_sessions.json")
    web_pages = _load("web_pages.json")

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not re.match(r"^hbp_prof_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", profile_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_id is invalid.")
    if not isinstance(instructions, str) or not instructions.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "instructions is required and must be a non-empty string.")
    if start_url is not None:
        if not isinstance(start_url, str) or not start_url.strip():
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "start_url must be a non-empty string when provided.")
        try:
            u = urllib.parse.urlparse(start_url)
            if u.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not u.netloc:
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "start_url must be an absolute http(s) URL.")
        except Exception:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "start_url must be a valid URI.")

    # Resolve profile and ensure attachable
    prof = next((p for p in profiles if p.get("profile_id") == profile_id), None)
    if not prof:
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Profile not found.", profile_id=profile_id)
    if prof.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Profile is not attachable to new jobs (must be active).", profile_status=prof.get("status"))

    # Create job row (queued -> running -> succeeded terminal)
    def _new_id(prefix):
        # ULID-like but offline: prefix + 26 Crockford base32 chars
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        # time component + randomness
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        rnd = uuid.uuid4().int
        chars = []
        x = (ts << 80) | (rnd & ((1 << 80) - 1))
        for _ in range(26):
            chars.append(alphabet[x & 31])
            x >>= 5
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(chars))

    job_id = _new_id("hbp_job_")
    job = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "tool_name": "openai_computer_use_agent",
        "profile_id": profile_id,
        "status": "queued",
        "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "instructions": instructions, "start_url": start_url},
        "output": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "cost_usd": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    if any(j.get("job_id") == job_id for j in jobs):
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Generated job_id collided; retry.")
    jobs.append(job)

    # Transition to running
    started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = started
    job["updated_at"] = started

    # Create agent session row (unique(job_id))
    if any(s.get("job_id") == job_id for s in sessions):
        job["status"] = "failed"
        job["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
        job["error_message"] = "Agent session already exists for this job."
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        job["finished_at"] = finished
        job["updated_at"] = finished
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Agent session already exists for this job.", job_id=job_id)

    session_id = _new_id("hbp_sess_")
    sess = {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "job_id": job_id,
        "agent_type": "openai_computer_use",
        "instructions": instructions,
        "transcript_storage_key": None,
        "final_url": None,
        "created_at": started,
        "updated_at": started,
    }
    sessions.append(sess)

    # Simulate execution success and persist artifacts pointers.
    # Business rule: transcript_storage_key MUST be set when job succeeds.
    final_url = start_url if start_url else None
    transcript_key = f"hbp_obj_transcript_{session_id}.jsonl"
    sess["transcript_storage_key"] = transcript_key
    sess["final_url"] = final_url
    sess["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Update profile last_used_at
    prof["last_used_at"] = sess["updated_at"]
    prof["updated_at"] = sess["updated_at"]

    # Cost computation (simple deterministic heuristic)
    # baseline + instruction length factor
    cost = 0.01 + min(0.20, max(0.0, (len(instructions) / 4000.0) * 0.10))
    job["cost_usd"] = float(max(0.0, round(cost, 6)))

    # Mark job succeeded
    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    job["status"] = "succeeded"
    job["finished_at"] = finished
    job["updated_at"] = finished
    job["output"] = {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "final_url": final_url,
        "transcript_storage_key": transcript_key,
        "job_id": job_id,
    }

    # Persist
    _save("profiles.json", profiles)
    _save("agent_sessions.json", sessions)
    _save("web_pages.json", web_pages)
    _save("jobs.json", jobs)

    return {
        "job": job,
        "session": sess,
    }

tool_schemas.name: claude_computer_use_agent
tool_schemas.description: This tool leverages Anthropic's Claude model to autonomously execute complex browser tasks with sophisticated reasoning capabilities using a cloud browser. It specializes in handling intricate, nuanced, or highly context-sensitive web interactions. Optimal for tasks requiring: - Complex reasoning over multiple web pages - Nuanced interpretation and flexible decision-making - Human-like interaction with detailed context awareness Best suited use cases include: - Multi-step processes requiring reasoning (e.g., detailed registrations or onboarding) - Interacting intelligently with advanced web apps - Conducting in-depth research with complex conditions - Extracting information from dynamic or interactive websites Provide detailed task instructions, relevant context, and clearly specify the desired outcome for best results. Returns the completed result or an error message if issues arise.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the agent session under.

instructions.description: Task instructions for the Claude-powered computer-use agent.

start_url.description: Optional initial URL to open before executing instructions.

tool_schemas.name: search_with_bing
tool_schemas.description: Runs a web search on Bing under the given profile and records the search execution, returning a slice of results according to offset and count. Results are paged using offset (starting at 0) and count (page size); repeat calls with increasing offset to retrieve more results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_id is invalid, query is empty/invalid, count < 1, offset < 0, or unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the profile does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the profile; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if search usage limits are reached.

profile_id.description: Hyperbrowser profile ULID to run the search under.

query.description: Search query string to send to Bing.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def search_with_bing(profile_id, query, count=None, offset=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid, urllib.parse, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0163000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0163000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    profiles = _load("profiles.json")
    jobs = _load("jobs.json")
    results = _load("search_results.json")

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not re.match(r"^hbp_prof_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", profile_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_id is invalid.")
    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "query is required and must be a non-empty string.")
    if count is None:
        count = 10
    if offset is None:
        offset = 0
    if not isinstance(count, int) or count < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "count must be an integer >= 1.")
    if not isinstance(offset, int) or offset < 0:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "offset must be an integer >= 0.")

    prof = next((p for p in profiles if p.get("profile_id") == profile_id), None)
    if not prof:
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Profile not found.", profile_id=profile_id)
    if prof.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Profile is not attachable to new jobs (must be active).", profile_status=prof.get("status"))

    def _new_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        rnd = uuid.uuid4().int
        chars = []
        x = (ts << 80) | (rnd & ((1 << 80) - 1))
        for _ in range(26):
            chars.append(alphabet[x & 31])
            x >>= 5
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(chars))

    job_id = _new_id("hbp_job_")
    job = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "tool_name": "search_with_bing",
        "profile_id": profile_id,
        "status": "queued",
        "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "query": query, "count": count, "offset": offset},
        "output": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "cost_usd": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    if any(j.get("job_id") == job_id for j in jobs):
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Generated job_id collided; retry.")
    jobs.append(job)

    started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    job["status"] = "running"
    job["started_at"] = started
    job["updated_at"] = started

    # Deterministically generate "total" results for the query and store N rows with contiguous ranks starting at 1.
    # Enforce unique(job_id, rank) and unique(job_id, url).
    # We'll generate a fixed corpus size based on query hash.
    h = int(hashlib.sha256(query.strip().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), 16)
    total = 25 + (h % 26)  # 25..50
    base_domain_seed = (h >> 8) & 0xFFFF

    # Create all results rows for this job once
    created_ids = []
    for r in range(1, total + 1):
        # generate unique URL per rank
        dom = f"example{(base_domain_seed + r) % 997}.com"
        path = urllib.parse.quote(query.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-"))
        url = f"https://{dom}/search/{path}/{r}"
        # uniqueness checks within this job
        if any(x.get("job_id") == job_id and x.get("rank") == r for x in results):
            job["status"] = "failed"
            job["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
            job["error_message"] = "Duplicate rank detected for this job."
            break
        if any(x.get("job_id") == job_id and x.get("url") == url for x in results):
            job["status"] = "failed"
            job["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
            job["error_message"] = "Duplicate url detected for this job."
            break

        result_id = _new_id("hbp_res_")
        row = {
            "result_id": result_id,
            "job_id": job_id,
            "rank": r,
            "title": f"{query.strip()} — Result {r}",
            "url": url,
            "snippet": f"Snippet for '{query.strip()}' (result {r}).",
            "provider": "bing",
            "created_at": started,
            "updated_at": started,
        }
        results.append(row)
        created_ids.append(result_id)

    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    if job["status"] == "failed":
        job["finished_at"] = finished
        job["updated_at"] = finished
        job["cost_usd"] = float(max(0.0, round(0.001, 6)))
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        _save("search_results.json", results)
        return _err(job["error_code"] or "CONFLICT", job["error_message"] or "Search failed.", job_id=job_id)

    # Cost: per search call
    job["cost_usd"] = float(max(0.0, round(0.0025 + 0.00005 * total, 6)))

    # Page slice
    job_results = [r for r in results if r.get("job_id") == job_id]
    job_results.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("rank", 0))
    slice_rows = job_results[offset:offset + count]

    job["status"] = "succeeded"
    job["finished_at"] = finished
    job["updated_at"] = finished
    job["output"] = {
        "provider": "bing",
        "query": query,
        "total_results": total,
        "returned": len(slice_rows),
        "offset": offset,
        "count": count,
        "results": [
            {"rank": r["rank"], "title": r.get("title"), "url": r["url"], "snippet": r.get("snippet")}
            for r in slice_rows
        ],
    }

    # Update profile last_used_at
    prof["last_used_at"] = finished
    prof["updated_at"] = finished

    _save("profiles.json", profiles)
    _save("search_results.json", results)
    _save("jobs.json", jobs)

    return {
        "job": job,
        "results": job["output"]["results"],
        "total": total,
        "offset": offset,
        "count": count,
        "has_more": (offset + count) < total,
        "next_offset": (offset + count) if (offset + count) < total else None,
    }

tool_schemas.name: create_profile
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new persistent Hyperbrowser profile with the provided display_name and returns the created profile record (including its profile_id). This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if display_name is missing/invalid or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the account has reached the maximum number of profiles it can create.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for the new persistent browser profile.

tool_schemas.name: delete_profile
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified persistent profile for deletion and returns the updated profile record/state once the delete request is accepted. This endpoint is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_id is not a valid Hyperbrowser profile ULID or unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the profile_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot delete the profile; raises CONFLICT if the profile is already deleted or is already in a deleting state and cannot transition again.

profile_id.description: The ULID of the Hyperbrowser profile to delete (e.g., hbp_prof_01H8...).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def delete_profile(profile_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, base64

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0163000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0163000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
        # Not a true ULID; fits vendor-visible pattern: prefix + Crockford base32 length>=10
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        chars = []
        x = ts
        for _ in range(10):
            chars.append(alphabet[x % 32])
            x //= 32
        import secrets
        for _ in range(6):
            chars.append(alphabet[secrets.randbelow(32)])
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(chars))

    t0 = time.time()
    jobs = _load("jobs.json")
    profiles = _load("profiles.json")

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not re.match(r"^hbp_prof_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", profile_id or ""):
        # Log job attempt (failed) per business rule: every tool invocation creates one jobs row.
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "delete_profile",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "profile_id is invalid.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_id is not a valid Hyperbrowser profile ULID.", field="profile_id")

    # Find profile
    prof = None
    for p in profiles:
        if p.get("profile_id") == profile_id:
            prof = p
            break

    if not prof:
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "delete_profile",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "NOT_FOUND",
            "error_message": "Profile not found.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Profile not found.", profile_id=profile_id)

    # Business rule: delete_profile transitions active -> deleting -> deleted.
    # Idempotency: if already deleting/deleted, treat as accepted and return current state.
    now = _now()
    job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
    job_input = {"profile_id": profile_id}
    started_at = now

    status0 = prof.get("status")
    if status0 not in ("active", "deleting", "deleted"):
        # Bad stored data; refuse as conflict
        finished = _now()
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "delete_profile",
            "profile_id": profile_id,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": job_input,
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "CONFLICT",
            "error_message": "Profile has an unknown status.",
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": started_at,
            "updated_at": finished,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Profile is in an invalid state.", status=status0)

    if status0 == "active":
        # Perform two-step transition immediately.
        # Step 1: active -> deleting
        prof["status"] = "deleting"
        prof["updated_at"] = now
        # Step 2: deleting -> deleted
        prof["status"] = "deleted"
        prof["updated_at"] = _now()
        # keep storage_bucket_key as-is; may be null/kept.
        _save("profiles.json", profiles)

        finished = _now()
        out = {"profile_id": profile_id, "deleted": True, "status": prof.get("status")}
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "delete_profile",
            "profile_id": profile_id,
            "status": "succeeded",
            "input": job_input,
            "output": out,
            "error_code": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": started_at,
            "updated_at": finished,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)

        return {"profile": prof, "job": {"job_id": job_id, "status": "succeeded"}}

    # If deleting or deleted: idempotent success, no transition.
    finished = _now()
    out = {"profile_id": profile_id, "deleted": (status0 == "deleted"), "status": status0}
    job_row = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "tool_name": "delete_profile",
        "profile_id": profile_id,
        "status": "succeeded",
        "input": job_input,
        "output": out,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": started_at,
        "finished_at": finished,
        "cost_usd": 0.0,
        "created_at": started_at,
        "updated_at": finished,
    }
    jobs.append(job_row)
    _save("jobs.json", jobs)
    return {"profile": prof, "job": {"job_id": job_id, "status": "succeeded"}}

tool_schemas.name: list_profiles
tool_schemas.description: Lists persistent Hyperbrowser profiles visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort key. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor; the response returns up to limit profiles and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, status/order is not one of the allowed values, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to list profiles for the account.

limit.description: Maximum number of profiles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous response.

status.description: Optional filter to only return profiles with the given status.

order.description: Sort order for returned profiles (prefix with '-' for descending).

tool_schemas.name: get_profile
tool_schemas.description: Fetches one profile by profile_id. Returns the profile if it exists and is visible to the caller. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the profile_id does not exist or is not accessible.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_profile(profile_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0163000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0163000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        chars = []
        x = ts
        for _ in range(10):
            chars.append(alphabet[x % 32])
            x //= 32
        import secrets
        for _ in range(6):
            chars.append(alphabet[secrets.randbelow(32)])
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(chars))

    profiles = _load("profiles.json")
    jobs = _load("jobs.json")

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not re.match(r"^hbp_prof_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", profile_id or ""):
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "get_profile",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "profile_id is invalid.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_id is not a valid Hyperbrowser profile ULID.", field="profile_id")

    prof = None
    for p in profiles:
        if p.get("profile_id") == profile_id:
            prof = p
            break

    if not prof:
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "get_profile",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "NOT_FOUND",
            "error_message": "Profile not found.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Profile not found.", profile_id=profile_id)

    now = _now()
    job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
    out = {"profile": prof}
    job_row = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "tool_name": "get_profile",
        "profile_id": profile_id,
        "status": "succeeded",
        "input": {"profile_id": profile_id},
        "output": {"profile_id": profile_id},
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": now,
        "finished_at": now,
        "cost_usd": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    jobs.append(job_row)
    _save("jobs.json", jobs)
    return {"profile": prof, "job": {"job_id": job_id, "status": "succeeded"}}

tool_schemas.name: list_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists execution records (jobs) for the caller, optionally filtered by profile_id, tool_name, and status. Returns a page of jobs ordered by created_at descending. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter is malformed.

profile_id.description: Only return jobs created under this profile.

tool_name.description: Only return jobs produced by this tool.

status.description: Only return jobs whose status is in this set.

created_after.description: Only return jobs created after this timestamp (exclusive).

created_before.description: Only return jobs created before this timestamp (exclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_jobs response.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def list_jobs(profile_id=None, tool_name=None, status=None, created_after=None, created_before=None, limit=None, cursor=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, base64

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0163000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0163000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _parse_dt(s, field_name):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return "BAD"
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return "BAD"

    def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        chars = []
        x = ts
        for _ in range(10):
            chars.append(alphabet[x % 32])
            x //= 32
        import secrets
        for _ in range(6):
            chars.append(alphabet[secrets.randbelow(32)])
        return prefix + "".join(reversed(chars))

    def _encode_cursor(obj):
        raw = json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")

    def _decode_cursor(cur):
        if cur is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(cur, str) or cur == "":
            return None
        pad = "=" * ((4 - (len(cur) % 4)) % 4)
        try:
            raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode((cur + pad).encode("ascii"))
            obj = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            return obj
        except Exception:
            return "MALFORMED"

    jobs = _load("jobs.json")
    profiles = _load("profiles.json")

    # Validate limit
    if limit is None:
        limit = 50
    if not isinstance(limit, int) or not (1 <= limit <= 200):
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "list_jobs",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "limit out of range.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "limit must be between 1 and 200.", field="limit")

    # Validate profile_id filter
    if profile_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not re.match(r"^hbp_prof_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", profile_id or ""):
            now = _now()
            job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
            job_row = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "tool_name": "list_jobs",
                "profile_id": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
                "output": None,
                "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "error_message": "invalid profile_id.",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            jobs.append(job_row)
            _save("jobs.json", jobs)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "profile_id is malformed.", field="profile_id")
        # FK existence check for filter reference (not required by vendor, but avoids silent typos)
        if not any(p.get("profile_id") == profile_id for p in profiles):
            now = _now()
            job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
            job_row = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "tool_name": "list_jobs",
                "profile_id": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
                "output": None,
                "error_code": "NOT_FOUND",
                "error_message": "profile not found.",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            jobs.append(job_row)
            _save("jobs.json", jobs)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Profile not found.", profile_id=profile_id)

    # Validate tool_name
    allowed_tools = {
        "create_profile", "delete_profile", "list_profiles",
        "scrape_webpage", "crawl_webpages", "extract_structured_data",
        "search_with_bing", "browser_use_agent", "openai_computer_use_agent", "claude_computer_use_agent"
    }
    if tool_name is not None:
        if not isinstance(tool_name, str) or tool_name not in allowed_tools:
            now = _now()
            job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
            job_row = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "tool_name": "list_jobs",
                "profile_id": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
                "output": None,
                "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "error_message": "invalid tool_name.",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            jobs.append(job_row)
            _save("jobs.json", jobs)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tool_name is not one of the allowed values.", field="tool_name")

    # Validate status array
    allowed_status = {"queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"}
    if status is not None:
        if (not isinstance(status, list)) or any((not isinstance(s, str) or s not in allowed_status) for s in status):
            now = _now()
            job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
            job_row = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "tool_name": "list_jobs",
                "profile_id": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
                "output": None,
                "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "error_message": "invalid status filter.",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            jobs.append(job_row)
            _save("jobs.json", jobs)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "status must be an array of allowed job statuses.", field="status")

    ca = _parse_dt(created_after, "created_after")
    if ca == "BAD":
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "list_jobs",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "created_after must be date-time.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "created_after must be an ISO 8601 date-time.", field="created_after")

    cb = _parse_dt(created_before, "created_before")
    if cb == "BAD":
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "list_jobs",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "created_before must be date-time.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "created_before must be an ISO 8601 date-time.", field="created_before")

    cur_obj = _decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cur_obj == "MALFORMED":
        now = _now()
        job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
        job_row = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "tool_name": "list_jobs",
            "profile_id": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
            "output": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "malformed cursor.",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job_row)
        _save("jobs.json", jobs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cursor is malformed.", field="cursor")

    # Apply filters
    rows = jobs[:]
    if profile_id is not None:
        rows = [j for j in rows if j.get("profile_id") == profile_id]
    if tool_name is not None:
        rows = [j for j in rows if j.get("tool_name") == tool_name]
    if status is not None:
        st = set(status)
        rows = [j for j in rows if j.get("status") in st]
    if ca is not None:
        rows2 = []
        for j in rows:
            dt = _parse_dt(j.get("created_at"), "created_at")
            if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime) and dt > ca:
                rows2.append(j)
        rows = rows2
    if cb is not None:
        rows2 = []
        for j in rows:
            dt = _parse_dt(j.get("created_at"), "created_at")
            if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime) and dt < cb:
                rows2.append(j)
        rows = rows2

    # Sort created_at desc
    def created_dt(j):
        dt = _parse_dt(j.get("created_at"), "created_at")
        if isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
            return dt
        return datetime.datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)

    rows.sort(key=created_dt, reverse=True)

    start = 0
    if isinstance(cur_obj, dict):
        if cur_obj.get("v") != 1:
            # treat as malformed
            now = _now()
            job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
            job_row = {
                "job_id": job_id,
                "tool_name": "list_jobs",
                "profile_id": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
                "output": None,
                "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                "error_message": "cursor version mismatch.",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            jobs.append(job_row)
            _save("jobs.json", jobs)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cursor is malformed.", field="cursor")
        after_job_id = cur_obj.get("after_job_id")
        if isinstance(after_job_id, str):
            for i, j in enumerate(rows):
                if j.get("job_id") == after_job_id:
                    start = i + 1
                    break

    page = rows[start:start + limit]
    has_more = start + limit < len(rows)
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and page:
        next_cursor = _encode_cursor({"v": 1, "after_job_id": page[-1].get("job_id")})

    # Record invocation as a jobs row itself
    now = _now()
    list_job_id = _gen_ulid_like("hbp_job_")
    out = {"jobs": [{"job_id": j.get("job_id")} for j in page]}
    job_row = {
        "job_id": list_job_id,
        "tool_name": "list_jobs",
        "profile_id": None,
        "status": "succeeded",
        "input": {"profile_id": profile_id, "tool_name": tool_name, "status": status, "created_after": created_after, "created_before": created_before, "limit": limit, "cursor": cursor},
        "output": out,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": now,
        "finished_at": now,
        "cost_usd": 0.0,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    jobs.append(job_row)
    _save("jobs.json", jobs)

    # Return full job rows in response
    return {
        "jobs": page,
        "limit": limit,
        "total": len(rows),
        "has_more": has_more,
        "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        "job": {"job_id": list_job_id, "status": "succeeded"},
    }
